stem: Plants show a stress pattern in one irrigation zone, no direct pest sign is confirmed, and root-zone measurements in that zone are abnormal. What is the strongest Technician II response?
choices: Label the issue a pest outbreak because leaf symptoms are present
Maintain a plant-health differential, verify the irrigation/root-zone evidence, continue appropriate scouting, and avoid forcing an IPM diagnosis without supporting signs
Recommend pesticide application as a diagnostic test
Move the affected plants to other zones to see whether symptoms spread
rationale: Symptoms can have multiple causes. When direct pest evidence is absent and a zone-specific root-zone abnormality exists, the diagnosis should remain open while relevant evidence is verified.
